__comment: PhotoPrism, a self-hosted photo server. No OAuth: the customUI app com.palm.app.photoprism-auth collects the server's address, the user name and the password (or an app password), and calls com.palm.service.photoprism/login, which signs in, makes the account its own app password with read-only scope ('albums config photos') and stores that, never the password. A PHOTO source only - no DOCUMENTS capability, no files app.
__comment2: com.palm.app.photoprism-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists.
__comment3: com.palm.service.photoprism is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for the photo-provider calls. The app password does not expire, so writeCredentials is unused after create (kept for symmetry).

capabilityProviders.__comment: Makes the PhotoPrism account a photo source. The Photos aggregator (com.palm.service.photos, its service name derived from the templateId) calls com.palm.service.photoprism/listAlbums+listPhotos and downloads each photo from the URL listPhotos gives: PhotoPrism's /dl and /t links, which carry the server's download and preview tokens, not the account's password or app password.
